name: Crocolisk Skin (Classic)
summary: In Loch Modan, crocolisk skins come from the fierce beasts that haunt the Loch’s islands and waters. Merchants and leatherworkers seek their durable hides, though hunters face danger to gather them.

sections.title: A Dangerous Trade
sections.body: Crocolisks crowd the Loch’s cold waters and make dens along its islands and shores. Their sharp teeth and thick scales make them dangerous quarry. Hunters based at Farstrider Lodge still pursue them for their hides. Tailors, leatherworkers, and merchants from distant places seek the skins for sturdy garments and armor, so undamaged hides bring a good price in the region.

faq.q: Where do crocolisk skins come from?
faq.answer: Loch Crocolisks and Large Loch Crocolisks in the waters and on the islands of the Loch in Loch Modan provide the skins.

faq.q: Who buys or trades these hides in Loch Modan?
faq.answer: Marek Ironheart, a dwarven hunter at Farstrider Lodge, gathers the skins and crocolisk meat to sell to visiting merchants and craftsmen.

faq.q: Why are these skins in demand?
aliases: what are croc skins used for
faq.answer: Merchants prize the tough, scaly hides for sturdy clothing and armor. The fierce crocolisks are hard to kill, so good skins bring steady pay.

faq.q: Is hunting crocolisks in the Loch considered dangerous?
faq.answer: Yes. Loch crocolisks are aggressive, with powerful jaws and serrated teeth that can sever limbs. Local hunters such as Marek Ironheart trade tales of near-fatal encounters as they try to pin down their quarry.

angles.text: As a hunter, you earn Farstrider Lodge’s respect by wading to the islands and subduing a thrashing crocolisk for its hide.
As a dwarf, you know Loch Modan’s crocolisks test the grit of mountaineers and lodge woodsmen.
